title: JSON blob append growth leaves

scope.rationale: JSONB construction now has source-shaped fast/slow byte append and grow-then-node append helpers.
excluded_responsibilities: JSONB node encoding beyond append dispatch

external_source_responsibilities: JSON blob growth and node encoding
dependencies.caller_closure: The normal append paths dispatch to these slow growth leaves on capacity exhaustion.

inputs: Mutable JsonParse, byte or node type/payload
outputs: Byte or encoded node appended when capacity/growth permits
contracts.ownership: JsonParse retains blob ownership; payload is borrowed and copied.
contracts.state_and_results: Fast byte append avoids growth; slow node path reserves payload plus maximum header before calling encoder.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Growth failure sets sticky OOM and leaves a valid prefix.

representation_differences: ArrayList capacity and item length replace separate C allocation and used counters.

oracle.protocol: Append at available and exhausted capacities with payload-size header boundaries and injected OOM.

assurance.oom: Growth failure preserves prefix and sets sticky OOM.
assurance.malformed_input: Payload size must fit the typed usize domain.
assurance.continuation: Sticky OOM suppresses successful future growth.
assurance.performance: Amortized constant byte append and linear payload copy.

integration.bounded_owner_retired: Normal appendNode now dispatches to the source-shaped growth leaf.

known_blockers: Focused JSONB growth/OOM trace and evidence-state promotion.

implementation_spans: Adjacent blob grow and node encoder
upstream_tests: Project JSON and broad runtime tests
